physical_pg_only_rule: No Liberty cell only admitted when every actual ODB ITerm is POWER/GROUND; no SIGNAL/CLOCK pins, no name exemption
stage_endpoint_method: Four signed coordinate extrema propagated through the full conservative combinational cell graph from each actual sequential/port/constant driver to sequential or output-port boundary. All clock pins included; combinational cells do not stop the stage. Multi-output cell dependence conservatively overapproximated.
limits: Geometric direct pin L1 and conservative summed combinational wire displacement, not timing signoff or routed wirelength.
All clock endpoints included by actual Liberty roles. PG separately enumerated by ODB sigtype; no clock/data name exemption.
